Project.Name: Gantt – Summary
Project.Title: Citizen Service Center Management Web System – Sprint Plan (Solo Scrum)
Project.Author: George Albeir Zalloum

Task.Name: Citizen Service Center Management Web System
Sprint 0 – Project Preparation & Analysis
Task.Notes: Project scope, literature review, functional requirements, methodology and sprint planning, architecture and technologies.

Task.Name: Sprint 1 – Account & Access Management
Task.Notes: Goal: Build the foundation of the system: accounts and authentication, uploading the citizen's ID card images at registration, dynamic departments, and the four roles with each department's data isolated, plus the activity log structure. Requirements: FR-AUTH-01, FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUTH-03, FR-AUTH-04, FR-AUTH-05, FR-AUTH-06, FR-AUTH-07, FR-VER-01, FR-DEP-01, FR-DEP-02, FR-DEP-03, FR-DEP-04, FR-DEP-05, FR-DEP-06, FR-DEP-07, FR-USR-01, FR-USR-02, FR-USR-03, FR-USR-04, FR-USR-05, FR-USR-06, FR-USR-07, FR-USR-08, FR-USR-09, FR-LOG-01, FR-LOG-02, FR-LOG-05, FR-SET-01

Task.Name: Sprint 2 – Service Builder & Request Decisions
Task.Notes: Goal: Enable the Department Manager to build the department's transactions dynamically without code and publish them to citizens in the service catalog, and build the logic of the employee's decisions on a request (review with access to the applicant's identity, requesting missing items, justified rejection, completion) within a controlled state machine. Requirements: FR-SRV-01, FR-SRV-02, FR-SRV-03, FR-SRV-04, FR-SRV-05, FR-SRV-06, FR-SRV-07, FR-SRV-08, FR-CAT-01, FR-CAT-02, FR-CAT-03, FR-VER-02, FR-PRC-03, FR-PRC-04, FR-PRC-05, FR-PRC-06, FR-PRC-07, FR-PRC-08

Task.Name: Sprint 3 – Request Submission, Payments & Archiving
Task.Notes: Goal: Enable the citizen to submit a request by uploading the required documents and paying the fees through Stripe in its test environment, and store requests with their attachments and decisions in an access-controlled electronic archive. Requirements: FR-REQ-01, FR-REQ-02, FR-REQ-03, FR-REQ-04, FR-REQ-05, FR-REQ-06, FR-REQ-07, FR-REQ-08, FR-REQ-09, FR-PAY-01, FR-PAY-02, FR-PAY-03, FR-PAY-04, FR-PAY-05, FR-PAY-06, FR-ARC-01, FR-ARC-02, FR-ARC-03, FR-SET-03

Task.Name: Sprint 4 – Request Assignment, Tracking & Notifications
Task.Notes: Goal: Deliver each request to the employees of the department that owns the service, enable the employee to take it without conflict and the Department Manager to follow and reassign the department's requests, enable the citizen to track the request by its reference number and timeline, send automatic email notifications on submission and at every status change, and alert the department about overdue requests. Requirements: FR-PRC-01, FR-PRC-02, FR-PRC-09, FR-PRC-10, FR-PRC-11, FR-TRK-01, FR-TRK-02, FR-NTF-01, FR-NTF-02, FR-NTF-03, FR-NTF-04, FR-SET-02

Task.Name: Sprint 5 – Feedback, Complaints & Performance Reporting
Task.Notes: Goal: Close the oversight loop: the citizen rates the service and the employee, complaints are routed to the correct administrative level and hidden from the person complained about, and dashboards, reports and activity logs support management in taking action. Requirements: FR-FBK-01, FR-FBK-02, FR-CMP-01, FR-CMP-02, FR-CMP-03, FR-CMP-04, FR-CMP-05, FR-CMP-06, FR-KPI-01, FR-KPI-02, FR-KPI-03, FR-KPI-04, FR-KPI-05, FR-KPI-06, FR-KPI-07, FR-RPT-01, FR-RPT-02, FR-LOG-03, FR-LOG-04
